📚 Back-to-School Campaign — New School Year

Give a Child the Tools to Succeed

A new school year is full of hope and possibility — but for many of the children we support, it also means stress. Without the right supplies, uniforms, and backpacks, these kids start at a disadvantage before they even walk through the school door.

Your donation goes directly to purchasing school essentials for the vulnerable children in our program — backpacks, notebooks, pens, uniforms, and anything else they need to start the year with confidence and dignity.

Our trusted local coordinator in Casablanca personally identifies each child's needs, buys the supplies, and delivers them directly — with care and accountability every step of the way.

Our Mission

Bringing dignity and joy to vulnerable children

We are a group of dedicated professionals with deep ties to Morocco who believe in giving back to the children and communities who need it most.

We have identified children in Morocco who are orphaned, living with disabilities, have absent or disabled parents, or are in extreme poverty. We support them throughout the year with clothing, gifts, and essential items — starting with seasonal celebrations as an example of the joy we strive to bring them every chance we get.

Our long-term vision is to grow our support to cover school expenses, tutoring, medical care, field trips, food, and more. Each campaign is fully transparent: every dirham spent is documented with receipts.

The children have been identified. The person receiving funds in Morocco is trusted. Your donation goes exactly where it should.

Our Impact

What we've accomplished together

Thanks to this community's generosity, we've already run successful campaigns for Eid El-Fitr and Eid al-Adha in 2026 — bringing new clothes, shoes, toys, and everyday essentials to vulnerable children across Casablanca. Every campaign has grown our reach, and we're looking forward to an even bigger impact with Back-to-School 2026 and the campaigns ahead.

On the Ground

Meet our coordinators

Our coordinators are the heart of Sponsor Kids 212 — trusted individuals embedded in their communities who identify the children, purchase the items, and ensure every donation reaches the right hands.

📍 Casablanca
Local Coordinator

Fatima Zahra فاطمة الزهراء

Fatima Zahra is a wife, mother, full-time worker, and student pursuing her degree in Human Resources — all while dedicating her heart to community service in Casablanca. She works directly with vulnerable families and children, connecting them with the clothing, food, medical support, school resources, and disability assistance they need. Her hands-on presence and genuine care for those around her make her an invaluable bridge between our donors and the children we serve.

Our Board

Meet the Board

Sponsor Kids 212 is run entirely by volunteers who believe deeply in this mission — here's the team steering it forward.

Adam

President & Founder

Adam was born in Meknès, Morocco, and now lives in West Chester, Ohio, with his wife and children. He holds a master's degree in Engineering Management from The Ohio State University and works as a Senior Manager in Technical Program Management in the aerospace industry, with a background in IT infrastructure and network engineering. He's passionate about empowering others and coaching them to reach their full potential. Outside of work, he loves traveling with his family, reading, learning languages, tackling DIY projects around the house, introducing young minds to technology, and staying active at the gym or on the soccer field with his kids.

Alesia

Secretary & Co-Founder

Alesia is a mother and wife who cares deeply about children's wellbeing. She holds a degree in business and brings experience from the insurance and benefits industry as well as teaching. She spends much of her time volunteering locally and teaching kids. Outside of that, she loves cooking and baking amazing bread, traveling, gardening — growing her own fruits, vegetables, and herbs — and crocheting. She lives in West Chester, Ohio.

Yassir

Co-Founder

Yassir was born in Casablanca, Morocco, and now lives in Liberty Township, Ohio. He's passionate about bringing the Moroccan community together, regularly volunteering his time at local events. With a background in Mechanical Engineering (from Northeastern University, Boston), he serves as Director of R&D in the CPG industry and holds an MBA from Indiana University. Driven by a love for building strong teams and turning worthy initiatives into reality, he also enjoys reading, spending time with family, and staying active through soccer and swimming.
